author: Gould, 1855
summary: 국내에서는 2022년 3월 소청도에서 처음 기록된 길잃은새로, 같은 해 5월과 11월에는 가까운 백령도의 오목눈이 무리 속에서 관찰되었는데 11월 개체 가운데 1마리는 뒤에 잡종으로 다시 판정되었다. 백령도의 개체는 중국 북부에 사는 아종으로 여겨지며, 2024년 10월에는 오목눈이와의 잡종으로 보이는 개체 여럿이 이 섬에 나타났다. 중국에만 사는 새로, 황허 유역의 화북에서 양쯔강 중·하류까지 분포한다. 오목눈이처럼 작은 무리를 지어 다니며, 번식하는 짝을 다른 개체가 도와 새끼를 함께 기르기도 한다.

art.subject: Silver-throated Bushtit (Aegithalos glaucogularis), adult (sexes alike, plumage similar year-round): a whitish to pale buff stripe along the centre of the crown, bordered on each side by a broad black band running from above the eye to the nape; a small warm buff patch between the bill and the eye; cheeks and sides of the neck pale greyish-white; a small dusky grey-black patch in the centre of the throat; back and rump grey; wings blackish with pale brownish edges to the tertials; breast and belly creamy white, the flanks and vent washed pinkish-buff; very long blackish tail with white outer edges; tiny stubby black bill; dark eye; pinkish-brown legs.
art.pose: clinging to a thin twig, side view, long tail held straight
art.scene: bare deciduous shrubs at a woodland edge on a Korean offshore island in late autumn, soft daylight; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view clinging to a thin twig: broad black lateral crown stripes either side of a whitish central crown stripe, cinnamon-buff forehead and lores, dark sooty-grey throat patch, grey back and rump, blackish wings, buffy underparts washed pink towards the vent, very long narrow dark tail held straight, tiny stubby black bill

adult, three-quarter front view perched on a twig: round head with broad black crown bands and a whitish central stripe, cinnamon-buff lores, dark eye isolated in the pale face, dark sooty-grey patch in the centre of the throat, buffy breast and belly washed pinkish, grey upperparts, very long tail
art.build: A tiny, round-bodied tit with a very long, narrow, graduated tail that is longer than the body, shaped exactly like the Long-tailed Tit of Korea. Body about the size of a Japanese White-eye's, the tail making the bird look much longer. Round head with no crest and almost no visible neck. Bill very short, stubby and triangular. Short pinkish-brown legs; clings to and hangs from thin twigs. Wings short and rounded, reaching only the base of the tail. In flight a small ball trailing a long thin tail; moves in small restless flocks.
avoid: Do not paint an all-white head; this species has broad black bands along the sides of the crown.
Do not omit the small dark throat patch; the Long-tailed Tit (Aegithalos caudatus) of Korea has a clean white throat.
Do not make the underparts clean white; they are washed pinkish-buff.
Do not give it a long or thin bill; it is tiny and stubby.
